players.product: release film for multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCC)

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyobo results briefing Q&A: Q&A Summary for Financial Results for Q1 FY 3/27 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A, CFO Hidekazu Takahashi presenting): demand for SRF and MLCC applications is remaining steady; the full production and full sales situation is continuing for SRF, and volume is increasing for MLCC use due to the expansion of the Utsunomiya Plant. The high-performance film field is expected to continue growing.

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyobo results briefing Q&A: Q&A Summary for Financial Results for Q1 FY 3/27 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): price revisions, particularly in Packaging film, are generally advancing, and the company intends to continue passing on raw material and fuel cost rises stemming from the situation in the Middle East; price revisions are difficult in fields such as Life Science. The full-year plan takes a cautious view of Films: Packaging film shipments for food-related applications are expected to slow over H2 on food price hikes, and the Middle East raw material and fuel price rises, limited in Q1, are expected to be reflected in a rise in cost of sales over H2.

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyobo results briefing Q&A: Q&A Summary for Financial Results for Q1 FY 3/27 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): Q1 saw an impact on net sales to the Middle East; the company anticipates gradual normalization, with recovery speed varying by business, such as reverse osmosis (RO) membranes for seawater desalination. In Environmental and Functional Materials, current demand remains generally steady, but the seasonal and other factors that strongly increased revenue in H2 of the previous fiscal year are not expected to have the same impact this year, and the company is factoring in the gradual impact of increased power and raw material costs.

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyobo results briefing Q&A: Q&A Summary for Financial Results for Q1 FY 3/27 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): in Life Science, the new plant for dialysis membranes has begun actual production and is working on production efficiency such as yield improvements; in contract manufacturing of pharmaceuticals, depreciation from facility upgrades is taking the lead while trial manufacturing aimed at new contracts advances; biotechnology sales are growing steadily due to the expansion of incubation facilities. The company expects improved profitability over H2 due to volume increases.

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyobo results briefing Q&A: Q&A Summary for Financial Results for Q1 FY 3/27 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): structural reform of the Airbag fabric business - transfer of the China site, dissolution of the North American site and consolidation into the Thai sites - is progressing as planned; productivity improvements and expanded sales are materializing, and the company expects a return to profitability during H2.
